video.title: AI欧腐《绝对服从/Unquestioning Obedience》
video.desc:
New recruit Jack joins the army to save his farm and meets drill sergeant Kane—whom he saved fourteen years ago. Kane uses his position to get close. After a jealous recruit and captain plot against them, a blizzard traps Jack and Kane in a mountain cabin, where they confess their feelings and expose the villains.
为了保住自家农场,新兵 Jack 参军入伍,遇到了教官 Kane,而 Kane 正是他十四年前救下的那个人。Kane 借职务之便一步步接近他。一名心怀嫉妒的新兵与上尉联手设计陷害两人,随后一场暴风雪又将 Jack 和 Kane 困在山间小屋。在那里,两人互诉心意,并最终揭穿了恶人的阴谋。
